name: Radio
description: A set of options where exactly one can be chosen. It's built on native radio buttons, grouped under a legend.

classes.ayy-radio: On <input type="radio">. Size follows density. aria-invalid="true" tints the ring destructive (dashed in High Contrast).
classes.ayy-radio--sm: Small circle (--ayy-size-check-sm) and small label text. Wins over the size of its group.
classes.ayy-radio--lg: Large circle (--ayy-size-check-lg) and large label text. Wins over the size of its group.
classes.ayy-radio-group: On the <fieldset> holding the radios. Vertical stack.
classes.ayy-radio-group--sm: Every radio, label and the legend in the group small, with tighter rows.
classes.ayy-radio-group--lg: Every radio, label and the legend in the group large, with looser rows.

default.looks: A circle --ayy-size-check wide with a line-hover border on a wash fill.

pressed.none: No pressed look; it picks on release.

focus.looks: 2px ring, 2px offset. Arrow keys move the choice within the group.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor. Forced colours: GrayText border.

selected.looks: Primary fill and border with a primary-fg dot that springs in.

error.when: aria-invalid="true" on each radio of the group

sizes.density: Each size grows a step with data-density.
sizes.width: Fixed circle. The group stacks (vertical) or wraps in a row (horizontal).

js: radioClass, radioGroupLegendClass constants; radioSizeClass(size?) → string | undefined (the --sm / --lg class); radioGroupClass({ orientation?, size?, className? }) → string

props.label: ReactNode — legend text
props.name: string — generated if omitted
props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — every radio, label and the legend in the group
"sm" | "md" | "lg" — this radio only; wins over the group (the native size attribute is not exposed)

a11y: Arrow keys move between radios in a group natively — no JS needed.
Always give the group a legend (label prop) and each radio a wrapping <label class="ayy-label">.
do: Use radios to pick exactly one of 2–6 visible options (plan, visibility, region).
Pre-select the most common option when there's a sensible default.
Set the size on the RadioGroup so every option, label and the legend change together.
dont: Don't use radios for more than ~6 options — use Select.
Don't use radios to switch views — use Tabs.
Don't use radios for independent on/off choices — use Checkbox.
Don't use a single radio on its own — use a Checkbox.
